notes.title: Patch 1.0.09 released!
notes.notes:
We hope you are enjoying playing Rumours From Elsewhere! We'd love to hear any feedback (good or bad!) to help us continue improving the game with regular updates. Many thanks to everyone who has contacted us so far

This patch includes the following fixes and updates:

[list]
[*] The Royal Guard playable character has new and improved Combo and Defense attacks and animations.

[*] After saving and loading a level, the next boss will now appear as expected.

[*] The Necromancer can now wall slide and ledge grab even when a summon is active.

[*] Library counters have been fixed to record the correct amounts.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.05 released!
notes.notes:
We hope you are enjoying playing Rumours From Elsewhere! We'd love to hear any feedback (good or bad!) to help us continue improving the game with regular updates.

This patch includes the following fixes and updates:
[list]

[*] New HUD update - you can now view key bindings for gamepad and/or keyboard on the HUD. This is turned ON by default, to turn OFF this feature head to the Options menu from either the Main Menu or Pause Menu and untick the feature

[*] We've removed that floaty feeling from the player jump

[*] Enemy NPCs will now no longer crowd platform edges

[*] Materials collected and traded are now recorded in the Game Statistics (viewable in the Library menu)

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.04 Released!
notes.notes:
We hope you are enjoying playing Rumours From Elsewhere! Please let us know if encounter any bugs or issues whilst playing and we will make it our priority to fix them. We'd also love to hear any other feedback to help us continue improving the game with regular updates.

This patch includes the following:

[list]
[*] HUD has been updated to show more inventory items, including potions and the equipped trinket
[*] New material trading options - players can now trade between common, uncommon and rare materials
[*] Improved knockback
[*] Player map shows whether discovered chests are opened or closed
[*] Tooltips have been added to the Character Selection menu to provide useful information
[*] Bug fixed for heavy weapon class playable characters freezing after being staggered during attack
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.03 Released!
notes.notes:
Happy playing! Be sure to let us know if encounter any bugs or issues whilst playing Rumours From Elsewhere and we will make it our priority to fix them.

This patch fixes the following bugs:
[list]
[*] Player was sometimes unable to attack or dash after resurrection
[*] Player fell endlessly into the void after falling from the Distant Lighthouse
[*] Level time limit has been increased by 2 minutes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.02 Released!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has played Rumours From Elsewhere so far, we have loved hearing your feedback! 
If you encounter any bugs or issues whilst playing Rumours From Elsewhere please let us know and we will make it our priority to fix them. 
This patch fixes the following bugs:
[list]
[*] Custom Key Bindings resetting to default after closing and restarting the game
[*] Sorcerer NPCs teleporting outside the Boss Arena 
[*] Required Video RAM has been reduced from 4GB to 3GB
[/list]
